title: Allahabad High Court (Justices J.J. Munir and Indrajeet Shukla, Sadab Ahmad v State of UP, judgment 26 Oct 2026, reported 13 Nov 2026 by Bar & Bench, LawChakra, NewsX): lenders may repossess a vehicle over a loan default only through a civil court or an arbitrator, not 'by force employing goons, styled as agents'; HDB Financial Services told to return the vehicle without precondition, restructure the loan at usual interest with no penal interest, ₹10,000 costs; owner says 31 of 45 EMIs paid (disputed); relies on SC Hari Dutta Sharma v State of UP (16 Sep 2026: truck taken ~1 am without 7-day notice, ₹10 lakh compensation, ₹4.5 lakh refund with 6% interest, RBI asked to ensure compliance)
